exposure: haematoma at the root of the umbilical cord
finding: Marginal cord insertion in the first trimester was associated with progression to furcate cord insertion in the second trimester, and higher incidences of SGA infants, abnormal placental morphology, retention of the placenta, and cord-related adverse pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: Marginal cord insertion that progressed to furcate cord insertion was associated with a higher rate of elective caesarean delivery (57.14% vs 35.71%, p < 0.001).
